cells.gaps: No source since October 2023 says refugees or displaced people may use SIM cards, mobile money or digital ID.
cells.note: Stage 3: UNHCR says 1,542 refugee certificates and ID cards were distributed in 2025, and Niger has issued 2,700 national identity cards to displaced people since 2019. Nothing says refugees may use SIM cards, accounts or digital ID, so not 4.
